TELC:sample.name: VPU_MEMORY_TRAFFIC

TELC:sample.name: PKG_IA_C0_ANY_SUM
TELC:sample.TELC:description: The counter value is incremented as a function of the number of cores that reside in C0 and active. If N cores are simultaneously in C0, then the number of "clock ticks" that are incremented is N. Counts in XTAL units.

TELC:sample.name: Reserved_IO_PKG_GCD_C0_ANY
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Reserved - (not implemented). This counter increments whenever GCD slices or unslices are ON and in C0 state. Counter rate is the Xtal clock.

TELC:sample.name: Reserved_IO_PKG_GCD_C0_ANY_RATIO
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Reserved - (not implemented). Follow exactly the PKG_GCD_C0_ANY_SLICE. The only change is that they do +N (GCD ratio) instead of +1 on the relevant clock edge. Counter rate is in Xtal Clock.

TELC:sample.name: Reserved_IO_PKG_MEDIA_C0_ANY
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Reserved - (not implemented). This counter increments whenever MEDIA slices or unslices are ON and in C0 state. Counter rate is the Xtal clock.

TELC:sample.name: Reserved_IO_PKG_MEDIA_C0_ANY_SLICE
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Reserved - (not implemented). This counter increments whenever any MEDIA slice is ON. Counter rate is in Xtal clock.

TELC:sample.name: Reserved_IO_PKG_MEDIA_C0_ANY_SLICE_RATIO
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Reserved - (not implemented). Follow exactly the PKG_MEDIA_C0_ANY. The only change is to do +N (MEDIA ratio) instead of +1 on the relevant clock edge. Counter rate is in Xtal Clock.

TELC:sample.name: Reserved_IO_PKG_MEDIA_C0_ANY_RATIO
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Reserved - (not implemented). Follow exactly the PKG_GCD_C0_ANY_SLICE. The only change is that they do +N (GCD ratio) instead of +1 on the relevant clock edge. Counter rate is in Xtal Clock.

TELC:sample.name: PKG_IA_C0_ANY
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts clocks that any IA core is active. Reference clock is XTAL.
